title: Studio logs a 404 for /layers on draft-only items and a 501 for /ai/models on every load
body:
## Source

Network and console readings on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15, one Studio session in the writable package `com.default.studio-test`:

- `GET /api/v1/meta/object/st_ticket/layers → 404` right after `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/st_ticket?mode=draft` created the object (Data pillar, unpublished object). The code already knows: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` carries three comments saying a draft-only name has no layer and `/layers` answers 404 for it, and `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` and `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` say the same, yet one load path still asks.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/view/st_ticket.default/layers → 404` when the Interfaces pillar opens an object entry whose default list view does not exist yet (the aside says "There is no list view st_ticket.default yet").
- `GET /api/v1/ai/models → 501 Not Implemented` on every console load, from the AI-model allowlist hook in `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` (around the comment at line 545, ADR-0028), on a server without `@objectstack/service-ai`.

Each is a red "Failed to load resource" line in the browser console; a developer reading the console for their own error sees three red lines that mean nothing.

## Target

1. A Studio load path never asks `/layers` for a name it already knows has no published layer: the drafts list answers "draft-only", and the object load, the view load and the inspector read it before calling `client.layered`. The three comments become the behavior.
2. The AI-model hook asks once per session and remembers a 501 (or 404) as "no AI service here" for the session; no retry on route changes. If the console can know in advance that the server mounts no AI service (its capability or health answer), it does not ask at all.
3. A Studio session that creates an object, opens its list view in Interfaces and creates a page logs no 4xx/5xx resource line.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (object and view loads), `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`; `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and `index.tsx` (the hook); tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Tests pin: no `layered` call for a draft-only object name; no `layered` call for a view name absent from both drafts and published; the models hook calls once and not again after a 501.
2. The network log of the session described above (reproduced in the PR as the list of `/api/` requests) shows no 404 or 501.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot test` green.

## Constraints

- No server change; the console stops asking.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12446
